name: Brook Kidron
line: The Kidron is a brook and valley below the eastern wall of Jerusalem, where altars were thrown out and Jesus crossed to a garden before His arrest.

moments.title: Altars thrown into the valley
moments.text: During Hezekiah's Passover celebration, the people removed the altars and incense altars in Jerusalem. They threw them into the Kidron Valley.

moments.title: Jesus crosses to the garden
moments.text: After He finished speaking to His disciples, Jesus went out with them across the Kidron Valley and entered a garden. Judas knew the place, and he brought soldiers and officers there.
